description: This is a Java interface defining data access methods for MerchantStore entities, including retrieving products and merchant store details by ID or code.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDao
classes.description: A Java interface for performing DAO operations related to MerchantStore entities, including retrieving product collections and merchant store details by ID or code.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of Product objects associated with a given MerchantStore; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its integer ID.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its string code; may throw ServiceException.
